maya_sales: Kicking off TerraForge-34B-slim POC request. Customer wants model compatibility check, cost compare (Hosted vs Dedicated), and answers to their security questionnaire. EU-only. Can eng review?
dave_eng_ml: I can take compatibility. Key Qs: do they need persistent per-tenant KV cache, and is tokenizer standard? Some TerraForge forks change byte-pair vocab.
maya_sales: They require per-tenant KV cache. Latency target 150ms p95 for 512 tokens. Prefers q8_0; tolerates q4_0 if accuracy delta >2%.
ana_platform: Ops note: EU deployment is fine for Dedicated. For Hosted with customer KMS, we need enterprise plan. Also need to confirm whether logs will store raw prompts — affects retention/KMS.
ravi_solutions: Please post their questionnaire link and any model artifact. Ill run a quick onboarding checklist and estimate eng days.
maya_sales: Link: https://files.company/terraforge/terra-poc-q.pdf They can provide HF id or tarball.
dave_eng_ml: If they can share tarball Ill run the inspector. Command we give customers: ./inspect_model --in terra-34b.tar.gz --format json. It returns tokenizer, kv_layout, rmsnorm flag. If tokenizer is non-standard we may need a small adapter (1-3 days).
ana_platform: KMS options: Dedicated supports BYOK with ACLs. Private requires customer-managed KMS. Hosted supports managed keys only unless enterprise KMS add-on. Also note disk encryption and EU data residency constraints.
tess_sales_ops: Pricing sketch: Hosted payg q8_0 per-token baseline. Dedicated reserved pool yields ~30-40% unit savings at steady throughput for 34B. I'll prepare a slide once batch size confirmed.
secbot: SECURITY BOT: Questionnaire flagged Q7 (data residency), Q12 (KMS rotation), Q18 (PII in logs). Security team, please review and reply in 48h. :lock:
ravi_solutions: Action items: 1) Dave to inspect tarball or review HF id. 2) Maya to collect questionnaire + tokenizer hash. 3) Tess to prep Hosted vs Dedicated TCO. 4) Ana to confirm KMS path and EU cluster availability.
maya_sales: On it. I'll ask for tarball and their KV layout doc now and update here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
